summary: Markets closed a turbulent week with major indexes posting weekly losses despite Friday's modest rebound, as Treasury yields whipsawed following the government's surprise announcement to double long-term debt buybacks. The S&P 500 fell 1.4% for the week while tech stocks bore the brunt of selling pressure amid bond market volatility, with the 30-year yield briefly touching a 19-year high above 5.33% before the Treasury intervention. Cryptocurrencies defied the broader risk-off mood, with Bitcoin surging 22% to $77,000—its best weekly gain since March 2024—after President Trump pushed Congress to pass the CLARITY Act and met with crypto executives at the White House. Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $517 million in single-day inflows, while crypto-related equities like Coinbase and Robinhood jumped 8% and 14% respectively. Geopolitical tensions escalated as Trump vowed "economic warfare" against Iran over Strait of Hormuz shipping disputes, lifting oil prices. All eyes now turn to Wednesday's Nvidia earnings and the July PCE inflation report as traders assess whether the AI trade can withstand higher-for-longer rates.

signals.title: Bitcoin surges 22% as Trump pushes CLARITY Act, Treasury doubles buybacks
signals.desc: Bitcoin posted its best weekly gain since March 2024, reaching $77,000, driven by Trump's White House meeting with crypto executives and regulatory clarity expectations alongside Treasury liquidity injection.

signals.title: Tech stocks shed 3% weekly as 30-year Treasury yield hits 19-year high
signals.desc: Information technology sector suffered sharp losses over five sessions as Treasury yields spiked above 5.33%, pressuring growth stock valuations and forcing risk reduction ahead of Nvidia earnings.

signals.title: US business activity hits fastest pace in over four years
signals.desc: August PMI data showed US business activity growing at its strongest rate since early 2022, supporting equity gains Friday and offsetting some bond market concerns.

signals.title: Treasury buyback announcement fails to durably suppress yields
signals.desc: Treasury's decision to double long-term debt repurchases initially drove yields lower Wednesday, but the rally evaporated Thursday as structural supply concerns resurfaced.

signals.title: Trump Iran sanctions threat lifts oil, adds inflation pressure
signals.desc: President's vow of "economic warfare" against Iran over Strait of Hormuz tensions pushed Brent crude to $91.66, reigniting inflation concerns and complicating Fed policy outlook.

verdict: Choppy conditions persist with bond volatility and geopolitical risk offsetting crypto euphoria; Wednesday's Nvidia report and PCE data will dictate near-term direction.
